requirements.text: Release pass now ('lets do the push to web now'): the orchestrator delivers the owner a plain-English, step-by-step instruction set for executing the pending single release pass (project-control/reports/release-request-2026-09-18-seq118.md sections 1-7 as ridden by sections 8-9: acceptances 228-236, deploy the then-current branch head, flags posture unchanged, one ~10-minute sitting) and stands by to answer questions. The EXECUTION itself remains OWNER-ONLY (production approval, Tier D / Section 20): the orchestrator performs no production deploy, flag flip, credential entry, or dashboard action itself.
requirements.required_harness: The instruction set is delivered in the owner chat in simple English (D-064) and points only at the already-reviewed release request document; no new production action is taken by the orchestrator.
requirements.required_evidence: The owner-facing instruction message in session; the unchanged release request document; absence of any orchestrator-side production/deploy/flag commit or action.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; instructions delivered in the same session turn.

requirements.text: Three loop lanes ('spint up 3 codex loops'): stand up THREE concurrent supervised build loops at fresh seams - each lane a normally contracted, claimed ledger packet with the full contract drill (binds + digest resyncs, seeds, G0 with the pairwise-disjointness record, claim with the FULL worktree path, worktree at/past the claim-seam commit, launcher retargeted with a fresh run-id) - and keep the lanes cycling (harvest, submit, independent review waves, accept at seams, re-feed finished lanes with the next released packet) until the released MVP queue is delivered or a genuine stop condition (blocker, Tier D / owner-only decision, gate FAIL, owner hold) is reached. Three lanes fills the D-072 maximum of three pairwise-disjoint loops and does not raise it.
requirements.required_harness: Launcher ACTIVE-TASK/run-id state, ledger transitions, and worktree layout show three disjoint claimed lanes; every relaunch follows the between-runs drill; no two lanes share an allowed_paths file.
requirements.required_evidence: Task packets + G0 disjointness records + claim/progress ledger entries + launcher state for the three lanes; DISCOVERY_BACKLOG seam notes.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; lanes contracted at the next seams.

requirements.text: MVP-queue resolution and scope boundary: 'the rest of the mvp' resolves to the RELEASED, NON-HELD queue only - phase B packets B2 through B5 in the recorded order of docs/PROPOSAL_EDITOR_PHASED_PLAN.md (B2 rule wiring next, then B3 live UI, then B4/B5; the named owner-review checkpoint after B3 per D-076-R003 stands), the DB-035 and DB-036 rider clusters, and subsequent released lanes contracted at seams under existing directives. This directive grants NO new scope: the expansion/3D hold (section 2, minus the D-040/D-076 scoped releases), Tier D / Section 20 hard stops, the PR #241 hold, the dependency-security policy, D-072 loop isolation, and every G0-G7 gate stay unchanged; phase C starts only after B3 is accepted and walked; phase D is not authorized; held work is never selected under this directive.
requirements.required_harness: Every packet contracted under this directive cites its normal directive_refs and passes G0; no packet touches held scope; B-phase ordering per the plan is visible in the contract sequence.
requirements.required_evidence: Task packets + G0 reports contracted under this directive; the unchanged hold notices.

requirements.text: Wiring preconditions carry-through (re-affirmed from the seq-120 handoff / T051-G5 + T053-seam records): whichever packet FIRST wires derive_proposal to a caller or route (B2 or B3) must bind, in-packet, the recorded preconditions - a LotContext list-size ceiling (lot-line/street-line lists), caller-coordinate finiteness guards (no NaN reaching an EvidenceRecord), the area_sq_ft bounded-repr instance (DB-034(b) fold-in), and DB-034(d) emission (the emits-1.1.0-only-when-block-present invariant enforced at the wiring seam).
requirements.required_harness: The derive_proposal-wiring packet's acceptance scenarios name each precondition; its gate wave confirms each closed or explicitly re-routed with reviewer sign-off.
requirements.required_evidence: The wiring packet's task JSON, scenario pack, and gate records naming the four preconditions.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; binds at the B2/B3 contract seam.
